policy_rename_reason: The old name implied Bariah named the population. She did not — she named three groups and wrote 'Their sub – perlu visual'. The 46 descendants were derived from the module's heading hierarchy. The policy is hers; the population is the module's. Conflating the two would attribute 46 individual rulings to a person who gave three.

obligations.visual_subject: A supervisor briefing and demonstrating a maintenance task to a work crew on site
obligations.rationale: One step visual per node, revealed as the learner steps the flow. Node identity and order are D-05 invariants.

obligations.visual_subject: A supervisor observing and checking garden maintenance work in progress
Nursery operations — seedling beds, potting and plant holding areas under supervision

obligations.source_heading: Penyeliaan Alatan dan Mesin Penyelenggaraan Taman
obligations.visual_subject: Maintenance tools and machinery being checked and accounted for
Garden inventory being recorded — stock, plants and materials counted against a list

obligations.source_heading: Perancangan Sumber Manusia dan Kebajikan Pekerja
obligations.visual_subject: Workforce planning and worker welfare — shift or duty allocation and welfare provision
obligations.rationale: The least concrete of the six; a simple diagram rather than an activity illustration.

obligations.visual_subject: The living elements the source names as soft landscape — trees, palms, shrubs and ground cover shown together as one category
obligations.rationale: The category-establishing visual and the screen's persistent main visual.

obligations.visual_subject: Watering in progress, supplying water to plants at the root zone
obligations.rationale: Main explanation visual for the operation.

obligations.visual_subject: The two implementation routes the source names — manual watering beside automatic irrigation
obligations.rationale: 'Kaedah Pelaksanaan' has no subject beyond the methods it groups. The composite IS the two method visuals shown together, so it consumes no additional asset. The heading still receives a visual — the composite.

obligations.visual_subject: A rubber hose with a spray nozzle in use
obligations.rationale: Hose and spray nozzle — the equipment the source names.

obligations.visual_subject: Sprinkler system beside drip irrigation — broad turf coverage against emitters at individual root zones
obligations.rationale: Sprinkler against drip in one frame. The two systems are LIST_ITEM rows, not headings, so they were never separate obligations; they are the two halves of this one.

obligations.visual_subject: PENDING — this heading groups four unrelated management topics and has no subject of its own in the source
obligations.rationale: A grouping heading with no body text of its own. Its four management topics each carry their own obligation and their own visual; a separate visual for the header would have to invent a subject the source does not supply. Class is PENDING_HUMAN precisely because no subject can be derived.

obligations.visual_subject: A watering schedule showing early-morning and late-afternoon slots, with midday excluded
obligations.rationale: Watering schedule with early-morning and late-afternoon slots.

obligations.visual_subject: Water supply and pressure across a site — source, delivery and the pump and timer the contractor maintains
obligations.rationale: Site-wide water supply, pressure, pump and timer.

obligations.visual_subject: The signs the source names — wilted dry leaves for under-watering against yellowed leaves and root rot for over-watering
obligations.rationale: Under-watering against over-watering; both failure directions must be in one frame or the teaching point is lost.

obligations.visual_subject: Water cost against watering method on a large project
obligations.rationale: Water cost against watering method.

obligations.visual_subject: Fertiliser being applied to supply nutrients to plants
obligations.rationale: Main explanation visual for the operation.

obligations.visual_subject: The three application methods the source names, side by side
obligations.rationale: As T04-VO-009 — the composite is the three method visuals shown together and consumes no additional asset.

obligations.visual_subject: Granular fertiliser spread evenly around the root zone or across turf
obligations.rationale: Granular fertiliser spread evenly — the broadcasting action.

obligations.visual_subject: Small holes dug around a tree's root zone, fertiliser placed in and covered back
obligations.rationale: Dig, place, cover — a three-step action needing sequence in one frame.

obligations.visual_subject: Liquid fertiliser sprayed directly onto foliage
obligations.rationale: Liquid fertiliser onto foliage — distinguishes leaf from soil application.

obligations.visual_subject: PENDING — grouping heading with no subject of its own
obligations.rationale: A grouping heading with no body text of its own. Its four management topics each carry their own obligation and their own visual; a separate visual for the header would have to invent a subject the source does not supply. Class is PENDING_HUMAN precisely because no subject can be derived.

obligations.visual_subject: A fertilising programme sheet showing fertiliser type, NPK rate, quantity and schedule
obligations.rationale: Programme sheet with the fields the source names — type, NPK, quantity, schedule.

obligations.visual_subject: Fertiliser checked against the contract specification and the S.O.'s approval
obligations.rationale: Specification check and S.O. approval shown as a gate.

obligations.visual_subject: Fertiliser stored dry, secured and away from any water source
obligations.reuse_note: Fertiliser storage is dry, secure and away from water. Pesticide storage is locked, labelled and ventilated. One asset would understate the pesticide requirement.
obligations.rationale: Dry, secure, away from water. Deliberately NOT reused for pesticide storage, which is locked, labelled and ventilated.

obligations.visual_subject: A worker handling chemical fertiliser wearing gloves and a face mask
obligations.reuse_note: Fertiliser PPE is gloves and a face mask. Pesticide PPE is respirator, goggles, chemical gloves and suit. One asset would understate the pesticide requirement.
obligations.rationale: Gloves and face mask for chemical fertiliser. Deliberately NOT reused for pesticide PPE, which is a materially heavier set.

obligations.visual_subject: A fertilising record showing date, fertiliser type, quantity and area treated
obligations.rationale: The record as evidence for a payment claim, which is the reason the source gives.

obligations.visual_subject: The three threats the source names — insect pests, fungal disease and weeds
obligations.rationale: The three threats — insect pests, fungal disease, weeds.

obligations.visual_subject: The IPM priority order — cultural, physical and biological control ahead of chemical
obligations.rationale: The IPM priority ORDER is the teaching point, so it is the screen's persistent main visual rather than a reveal.

obligations.visual_subject: Good maintenance practice as prevention — correct watering and balanced fertilising
obligations.rationale: Prevention through correct watering and balanced fertilising — connects back to the two operations already taught.

obligations.visual_subject: Diseased plant material removed by hand and weeds pulled out
obligations.rationale: Manual removal and weeding.

obligations.visual_subject: A pest's natural enemy used against it
obligations.rationale: A pest's natural enemy — no obvious photograph, so a relationship diagram.

obligations.visual_subject: Controlled, targeted pesticide application rather than blanket spraying
obligations.rationale: Controlled and targeted application, not blanket spraying.

obligations.visual_subject: The three pesticide types the source names, side by side with their targets
obligations.rationale: Type paired with target for all three. This is the screen's main visual.

obligations.visual_subject: Insecticide and the insect pests it controls
obligations.rationale: Insecticide and its target are one labelled panel inside T04-VO-034's comparison. Splitting the three apart would destroy the pairing the source teaches. The obligation is discharged by that panel.

obligations.visual_subject: Fungicide and the fungal disease it controls
obligations.rationale: As T04-VO-035 — fungicide panel.

obligations.visual_subject: Herbicide and the weed growth it controls
obligations.rationale: As T04-VO-035 — herbicide panel.

obligations.visual_subject: PENDING — grouping heading with no subject of its own
obligations.rationale: A grouping heading with no body text of its own. Its four management topics each carry their own obligation and their own visual; a separate visual for the header would have to invent a subject the source does not supply. Class is PENDING_HUMAN precisely because no subject can be derived.

obligations.visual_subject: Pesticide use under statutory control, and a licensed operator's credential
obligations.rationale: Statutory control and a licensed operator's credential. The unit's highest-consequence visual; accuracy matters more than style here.

obligations.visual_subject: Full PPE for pesticide work — respirator, safety goggles, chemical gloves and protective suit; locked labelled ventilated store; Safety Data Sheet on file
obligations.reuse_note: See T04-VO-025 and T04-VO-026 — this is the heavier pesticide set that must not be shared with the Baja screens.
obligations.rationale: Full pesticide PPE. Base-visible under D-04 and may not be moved behind a reveal.

obligations.visual_subject: Calm-weather spraying with no drift, warning signage posted, and a spray record
obligations.rationale: Calm-weather spraying, signage and the spray record — three separate obligations in one frame.

obligations.visual_subject: The permanent built elements the source names as hard landscape, shown as one category against the soft-landscape category
obligations.rationale: The category and its contrast with soft landscape.

obligations.visual_subject: Walls, fences and level changes dividing outdoor space into distinct areas, with pathways, driveways and steps as movement routes
obligations.rationale: Space-making and circulation are one function group in the source.

obligations.visual_subject: A retaining wall holding a slope, with drains and graded surfaces carrying run-off
obligations.rationale: Retaining wall and drainage — both engineering roles in one image.

obligations.visual_subject: Patios, decks and plazas in use, with gazebos, benches and landscape lighting
obligations.rationale: Usability is shown by people using the space; the only obligation in the unit where photo direction is the natural treatment.

obligations.visual_subject: Stone, timber and concrete adding texture, colour and pattern, and the contrast hard elements make against planting
obligations.rationale: Contrast needs two things in one frame — that is the source's own point.
